text:
matt: Quick heads-up — planning a small canary push tonight 23:00 UTC. Need temporary prod deploy rights for @maria and @raj to validate telemetry + perf. Change window 23:00-00:30 UTC. Who can hand off? MFA required per policy.

sarah: Prefer an ephemeral svcacct with narrow perms (deploy + read-logs), TTL 90m. Avoids mass human grants. :+1:

maria: svcacct sounds good to me. If we need human fallback I have hardware MFA ready.

raj: I need to run smoke + embedding regression checks. svcacct is fine but please ensure it can't do full rollout.

sre-bot: No active prod alerts in the last 2h — risk forecast: low. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary job queued: `deploy canary v1.12.3 --target=canary --timeout=30m`. Logs stream -> /deploys/4832109999.

matt: Decision: create ephemeral svcacct infra-canary-4832 with deploy + logs-read, TTL 2h. Add @maria and @raj to iam-binding for that svcacct. Pin canary to v1.12.3.
Rollback criteria (agreed): >3 errors/min sustained for 5m OR p50 latency regressed >15% vs baseline.

sarah: Also add automatic fallback to v1.12.2 if rollback triggered. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-fallback — follow steps 1-4.

maria: Confirmed — I'll press canary at ~23:05 and run smoke/perf scripts. If anything suspicious I'll :rotating_light: and trigger rollback.

raj: I'll monitor the embeddings pipeline and the KV cache hitrate. Standby to flip to v1.12.2.

matt: Note: MFA still required for any human to initiate a full rollout. svcacct can only perform canary. To escalate to full rollout, open #eng-releases and tag @oncall.

sarah: Logging release note: "canary v1.12.3 — batching perf tweak, expected ~5% token-cost reduction; monitor latency and RR."

maria: Starting canary now (23:05 UTC). Will post quick pass/fail.

deploy-bot: Canary started 2025-11-15T23:05:12Z for id=4832109999. Live stream: https://deploys.redwood/p/4832109999

matt: Thanks all — handoff complete. If rollback needed use: ```deploy rollback --to v1.12.2 --id 4832109999``` and ping @sre for coordination.

sre-bot: Acknowledged — alerts wired to oncall; automated rollback toggle ready. :shield:

maria: Smoke tests passed, perf looks nominal. No regressions. Will keep monitoring for 30m and then hand back creds.

matt: Closing thread. Documented in release notes and change log.
